defaultConsumptionPolicy: Start with exact owner-current facts and the immediate consumer task.
If those facts expose the decisive distinction, use them directly.
Load the smallest relevant shared Foundation/Knowledge only when causal reconstruction, transfer, ambiguity, negative-transfer detection, or missing structure creates demonstrated burden.
Hydrate exact owner-local causal history when shared doctrine is insufficient.
Revalidate current truth with the owner; never let frozen research/theory acquire current mutation or action authority.

refinements: A10: preserve action-relevant UNKNOWN/non-collapse under missing/stale/conflicting/insufficient evidence.
Primitives Contract: identity follows owner-named meaning-bearing invariants; label/byte/name/revision equality alone is neither necessary nor sufficient.

finalKnowledge: Current use, future option value and capability value are distinct; no universal option-value scalar follows.
Invariant-bound identity has cross-owner negative support while exact identity tuples remain owner-native.
Reusable causal explanations preserve defeated alternatives/falsifiers/counterfactual breakage/negative-transfer boundaries when future transfer or reopening matters.
Theory reopen conditions are not evidence sufficiency, research reopening, or owner action admission.
Indexes/Atlases navigate; they do not become causal truth or current owner authority.
Mechanically owned truth-role/currentness/authority facts should be projected mechanically when useful, without turning metadata into universal schema.
Compression is receiver-conditioned and must be judged by whole accepted-work cost, not payload size alone.
Foundations are reconstruction/transfer priors, not default per-decision Context when owner-current facts already expose the decisive distinctions.

ownerLocalRetentions.rule: Exact OFR3 causal histories remain owner-local evidence; only independently converged implementation-independent intersections enter shared doctrine.

programmeBoundary.ownerTruthBoundary: Programme evidence may explain shared invariants but never replaces owner-current truth or action authority.

programmeNonGoalsAfterCloseout: No Grand Unified Ordivon Theory document as a new authority.
No re-documentation campaign across owners merely for completeness.
reopenConditions: Fresh Agents repeatedly make consequential errors because the decisive causal distinction is absent from direct owner facts, and a foundation-selection treatment has a plausible falsifier against strong retrieval/direct-evidence baselines.
Owner-local causal history becomes unrecoverable often enough to cause repeated costly archaeology or unsafe restoration of defeated mechanisms.
Multiple materially different owners reproduce an unowned non-bypassable responsibility whose local implementations create measurable drift/cost and whose deletion breaks more than one real workload.
A materially different consumer independently validates C9 consumer-pressure descent or M18 role-level hydration beyond the current shared-method/corpus boundary.
New owner evidence directly contradicts UNKNOWN non-collapse, invariant-bound identity, or another retained cross-owner claim in its stated scope.
